title: Functional Fitness Foundations
author: Colton J.
desc: A 12-week program focused on retraining your body to have a solid base for functional fitness. The idea is that you will follow this program to find your baseline, then move on to bigger and better things. Or, take a rest week/deload at the end (Week 13), and restart the plan by increasing weight and run times. Additionally, you can trade out the long runs for rucks or walks uphill if you need training in that area. Farmer's carry (Or Day 6 in General) can be replaced with sled push or functional movements. I built this program from my own knowledge of functional fitness and how I want my body trained for my occupation. This is geared towards military/first-responders who want to train for the job and not for competition or looks.

25 Minute Interval Run

As Follows (In-Order):
5 Minute Warm-Up Jog/Walk
5 Minute Run - 9:30/Mile Pace
10 Minutes Repeat 5x Sets:
1:00 - 8:00/Mile Pace
1:00 - Jog/Walk Rest
5 Minute Cooldown Walk/Jog

Tempo Run:

20 Minute Run - Controlled Lactate Threshold

(Just under maximum effort, pull-back speed if feeling overtrained.)

Slow Run @/Close-To Zone 2 HR

(Can replace occasionally with ruck or walk uphill.)
